title: brainstorm — concept seeds
description: Output of the brainstorm planner: a JSON array of exactly N concept seeds (N is set by the creativity lever). Names must be distinct. One artifact is the source of truth the output conforms to; grading criteria live in .claude/references/craft-bar/deliverable-brainstorm.md.

name.description: Short concept label; must be distinct across the seeds.

brief.description: Self-contained spec the idea agent needs: the angle, the hook, a rough beat arc, which capability it leans on (a technique from techniques.json), and any 'OPEN QUESTION:' lines. A roadmap-feasibility technique must be flagged 'needs <service>'.
